resources.string: Express your current emotions in 3-4 sentences.
How are you feeling right now? What thoughts occupy your mind? Share freely...
Write at least a few sentences to continue
Please fill in the demographic information below.
I don\'t want to say it
Have you ever been diagnosed by a mental health professional? (If \'yes\', please write your diagnosis below)
If you have received psychological and/or psychiatric treatment before, what type of treatment(s) did you receive? (Leave blank if none)
Over the last week, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way
Please answer \'Not at all\' to this question.
Over the last week, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen
Below is a list of statements dealing with your general feelings about yourself. Please choose the option that best describes you.
I feel that I\'m a person of worth, at least on an equal plane with others.
I feel that I have a number of good qualities.
All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
I am able to do things as well as most other people.
I feel I do not have much to be proud of.
I take a positive attitude toward myself.
On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.
I wish I could have more respect for myself.
I certainly feel useless at times.
At times I think I am no good at all.
This scale consists of a number of words that describe different feelings and emotions. Indicate to what extent you have felt this way RIGHT NOW.
Very slightly or not at all
Please rate your current emotion in terms of negativity-positivity. 1 represents feeling completely unhappy/negative, while 9 represents feeling completely happy/positive.
Please rate your current emotion in terms of calmness-arousal. 1 represents feeling completely calm, relaxed, or sluggish, while 9 represents feeling completely aroused, excited, or jittery.
This questionnaire is designed to measure how you feel about yourself at this moment. There are no right or wrong answers.
I feel satisfied with the way my body looks right now.
I feel frustrated or rattled about my performance.
I am worried about what other people think of me.
I feel that I am not doing well at things.
I am worried about looking foolish.
Please select \'Neither Agree nor Disagree\' for this question.
We are preparing a personalized message for you...
💡 Taking a deep breath can reset your nervous system
🌱 Every small step toward self-awareness matters
✨ Expressing yourself honestly is a sign of courage
\"Every moment is a fresh beginning.\" — T.S. Eliot\n\nEven when facing barriers, your willingness to reflect shows incredible strength.
How did this message make you feel? Do you feel any better?
Thank you for taking the time to reflect on your well-being. Remember, every step toward self-awareness is a step toward growth.
